# Routine Streaks 1.3.0

## Improvements

- Added routine reordering in plugin settings.
- Routine cards can now be dragged from the grip handle to place them above or below another routine.
- Added up and down controls as an alternate way to reorder routines without dragging.
- The saved routine order is used across settings, widgets, template suggestions, and Scriptable exports.

## Notes

- Reopen the Routine Streaks settings tab after updating if Obsidian still shows the old settings UI.
